description.narrative: The BSI course was delivered to 35 participants with representatives from the Tajik Border Guards, CBRN Safety and Security Agency, and Committee for Emergency Situations. title.narrative: International Counterproliferation Program (ICP): International Dual-Use Investigations (IDUI Course

description.narrative: The International Dual-Use Investigations Course was delivered to 40 participants from the Tajik Customs Service, Border Guards, CBRN Safety and Security Agency, and Committee for Emergency Situations. The primary objectives of this event were to enable better interagency understanding among Tajik law enforcement entities of their respective authorities, capabilities, processes, and objectives as they relate to dual-use investigations; enhance participants understanding of likely dual-use items or materials that they may encounter in the performance of their duties;eEmphasize the importance of both interagency and international coordination and cooperation during dual-use investigations; and demonstrate the dispersed nature of proliferation networks and their use of various transshipment points to enable proliferation schemes. ....
